title: SSV Analysis Scripts
summary: This module provides scripts for analyzing Sparse SAE Vectors (SSVs), including clustering features and generating corpus-based interpretations for better understanding of model behavior.

nodes.label: Cluster SSV Features & Causal Analysis
nodes.title: SSV Feature Clustering and Causal Analysis
nodes.description: Clusters Sparse SAE Vector (SSV) features, performs causal steering experiments, and evaluates the impact of feature clusters on model output.

nodes.label: Corpus-based SSV Interpretation
nodes.title: Corpus-based SSV Feature Interpretation
nodes.description: Extracts and interprets SSV features using a corpus, generating human-readable explanations and scoring their detection accuracy.

nodes.label: SAE Experiment Runner

nodes.description: Manages and executes various Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) experiments, including ablation and reconstruction.

nodes.label: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.title: SAE Optimization Scripts
nodes.description: Contains scripts for optimizing Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) parameters and configurations.
